name: James
overview: The New Testament introduces two apostles named James: James the son of Zebedee, who was called by Jesus while mending nets with his father and brother John, and James the son of Alphaeus. James the son of Zebedee was part of Jesus’ inner circle, present at significant moments such as the transfiguration and was closely associated with Peter and John. Additionally, the James identified as a brother of Jesus highlights the familial ties within Jesus’ earthly life. These passages emphasize James’ integral role among the apostles and within Jesus’ ministry.
